phases.name: A Lover Spurned
phases.say: (Its sweetness curdles; now it wants you only to ruin you.)

say.open: Stay. Stay with me. Why would you ever go home?
say.death: You would have been... so happy...

bestiary.lore: The card of choice and union, made flesh: a tempter who will have one of you, whichever you choose.
bestiary.weakness: Holy, heavily. Guard the strongest from the whispers.
bestiary.pattern: Every third turn a whisper charms the strongest; heartbreak on a row and a leaping poisoned kiss on the Back between. Spurned, it whispers every other turn.
